description:
Tension Relief Music | Sarangi Instrumental | 1.5 Hours of Slow, Warm Release

The day is over but your body has not been told. Jaw tight, shoulders high, a knot in the chest that followed you home.

This warm Indian instrumental music is designed to help your body let go of the day - the sarangi's long, singing notes invite slower breathing and give held muscles permission to soften.

Enjoy 1.5 hours of slow, expressive sarangi over a soft tanpura drone, with no vocals, no sudden changes and nothing asking for your attention.

Perfect for the end of a long workday, releasing tight shoulders and jaw, stressful weeks, gentle stretching, a warm bath, quiet tea, journaling, screen-free evenings, meditation, or resting before bed.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instrument: Sarangi with tanpura
Raga: Desh (warm and heartfelt)
Style: Indian classical instrumental
Mood: Warm, releasing, unhurried
Atmosphere: A quiet room at the end of a long day
Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes

🎧 HOW TO USE
Put your bag down, sit back, and let your shoulders fall. Unclench your jaw and breathe out slowly. There is nothing to achieve while this plays. Headphones recommended.

⏱ CHAPTERS
0:00 You can stop now
9:00 Setting the day down
18:00 A long, slow breath
27:00 Softening the shoulders
36:00 The jaw unclenches
45:00 Warmth through the chest
54:00 Nothing left to carry
1:03:00 The body settles
1:12:00 Quiet strength returning
1:21:00 Rested and lighter

⏱ BEST FOR
• The end of a long workday
• Tight shoulders, neck and jaw
• Stressful weeks
• Gentle evening stretching
• A warm bath or quiet tea
• Screen-free evenings
• Journaling and reflection
• Meditation
• Resting before bed
• Recovering after a demanding day

If this music helped you release the day, subscribe to Raga Focus for more uninterrupted Indian instrumental music.
